messages:
Aisha: Noticed anomaly in this week's launch dashboard — demo conversion up 36% Thu but pipeline MQL quality looks off. Anyone digging? :thinking:
Leo: I pulled raw leads. There's a concentration from 'webinar_launch_b' with very high demo clicks but CTR doesn't match landing engagement.
Vik: We shipped a micro-redirect to /r/launch on Wed for vanity tracking. CDN team added a param-strip for cache keys. Could that lose utm_campaign?
Leo: Quick SQL: SELECT utm_campaign, count(*) FROM clicks WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-24' AND '2026-03-26' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC; shows webinar_launch_b with 4.1k rows but 92% have utm_medium=NULL.
Aisha: Null mediums default to 'direct' in ETL which inflates last-touch attribution for the campaign. That explains the demo spike in the dashboard but not true engagement.
Vik: ops-bot: CDN change CDN-1199 (query-strip) was deployed 2026-03-23T20:10Z to reduce cache cardinality. I had flagged it but it went live during the push.
Aisha: Can we revert CDN-1199? Fast fix preferred so KPI deck isn't misleading. Also plan a corrected backfill for analytics.
ops-bot: Revert request queued for CDN-1199. Approver: leo.
Leo: Approved. Reverting now.
ops-bot: Revert applied for CDN-1199 (2026-03-25T02:18Z UTC).
data-bot: data-refresh: clicks table refreshed (2026-03-25T02:25Z).
Leo: Re-ran the SQL: webinar_launch_b now shows utm_medium mostly 'organic_social' again. Corrected demo-attributed count drops from 4.1k -> 1.1k.
Aisha: For tomorrow's KPI review I'll include: (1) Reported vs Corrected demo counts, (2) A short bench note explaining the artifact, (3) Action items to prevent recurrence.
Vik: Action items: add a unit test to CDN-1199 to preserve utm_* parameters for /r/*; add an alert for >25% channel-mix daily change; add a dashboard annotation template for attribution corrections.
Aisha: Owners: Vik for CDN test (due 2026-04-02), Leo for backfill ticket if leadership requests (ETA 4h), Data to add corrected line in KPI deck (I'll handle slide).
Leo: Filed ticket MK-4320 (ETL backfill) and MK-4321 (deck annotation).
Aisha: Thanks team. We'll present the corrected numbers and the bench narrative in the sync. :white_check_mark:
